review.capture_basis: 18 selected staged native photographs: experimental v4 A/42 and B/43 (generator revision 6) and production normal/42 lower entry (generator revision 4). Actual production scene, supported floor/capsule and exactly matching 100/8 camera poses; saved environment and real held torch. Keys, camera locations, fuel, actors and hazards staged/frozen only for photography. Recorded connected-door entry uses ordinary player input and natural RouteLighting, with no manual ignition or added lighting. Distant darkness is retained. These are not human pacing, pressure/fuel balance, browser, promotion or approval evidence. Mixed helper batches: the 16 A/B images use the preserved original helper; the 2 normal images use a retry helper adding normal-only selection and choosing its supported lower entry marker instead of the failed raised landmark. A/B camera behavior and production sources are unchanged. Exact helper snapshots, diff, raw receipts and logs are retained. Two original normal support failures are excluded from the selected set but preserved in prior_attempt_failures and its raw receipt. Normal retry wrote both images successfully, then reported ObjectDB/resource shutdown leaks; it is not described as an entirely clean run. Runtime rendering matches checkout; full config hash equality was verified at aggregation.
